live_gate_reason: No ComfyUI installation was reachable on this development host when COMPAT-001 ran. Every value below is a contract expectation derived from documented ComfyUI behavior, not an observation.

installation._note: CATALOG-001 must fill these from /system_stats and the installed custom_nodes listing once a live installation is configured. Record the exact commit, not a branch name.

checked_on_this_host: directory scan for names containing 'comfy' under the user profile, Program Files, Program Files (x86), and drive roots (only this repository matched)
discovery._note: The repository defines no configuration convention yet; backend/ does not exist. FOUNDATION-001 owns the real config surface (ComfyUI URL plus input/output/temp roots). Nothing here may be treated as an auto-discovery fallback: a guessed path is not explicit configuration.

GET /queue.purpose: reconciliation of running and pending jobs

POST /upload/image.purpose: image and mask upload into the input directory

POST /interrupt.purpose: global interrupt of the RUNNING job

submission_contract.partial_acceptance: A 200 response with a prompt_id may still carry node_errors for individual output branches. A successful submission is not proof the whole workflow will execute. See events/partial_failure.events.jsonl.
submission_contract.idempotency: UNVERIFIED. Do not assume supplying a prompt_id makes submission idempotent, even where a newer server accepts one. GEN-001 must reserve a profile-scoped request key locally and enter submission_unknown on a lost response rather than resubmitting.

running_job.risk: Interrupt stops whichever job is currently RUNNING. Between a queue read and the interrupt call, another profile's job can become the running job, so a stale queue check is not a safe guard.
running_job.required_behavior: Only offer running-job cancellation when the installation exposes a per-job cancel that names the prompt_id and a probe confirms it. Otherwise disable running cancellation and state the unavailable capability. Never expose global queue or history clearing.

cancellation.expected_event_on_cancel: execution_interrupted, followed by history carrying status.status_str 'error' with an interruption marker. See events/cancelled_run.events.jsonl.

output_descriptor_contract.images_key: Core SaveImage returns ui.images entries of {filename, subfolder, type}, where type is 'output' or 'temp'.
output_descriptor_contract.video_key: Core SaveVideo and SaveWEBM also report under ui.images with a video container filename; some third-party packs report under 'gifs' or a pack-specific key instead.
output_descriptor_contract.rule: UNVERIFIED against a live installation. MEDIA-001 must key media classification off the actual descriptor plus file extension and treat an unknown descriptor key as an unresolved output, not as an empty result.
output_descriptor_contract.temp_outputs: type 'temp' is ephemeral. It becomes a saved gallery item only after a verified private capture.

LoadImage.binding: A bare filename relative to the configured ComfyUI input directory; subfolders appear as 'sub/name.png'.
LoadImage.upload_route: POST /upload/image (multipart: image, optional subfolder, optional type, optional overwrite)
LoadImage.application_rule: Stage uploads under an application-owned subfolder and substitute the staged filename at submission. Never expose the shared input-directory listing as a cross-profile dropdown.

video_upload.application_rule: There is no universal video-upload route. INPUT-001 must establish the actual loader filename contract for whichever video loader the installation provides, and show an actionable diagnostic when no adapter exists.

release_blockers: No live ComfyUI revision, node pack list, or device report recorded.
Output descriptor shapes for video are assumed from upstream source, not observed.
Cancellation capability is unprobed; per-job running cancellation must be treated as unavailable until proven.
